browserObservations.version: Veyra current planner desktop keyboard path
browserObservations.observed: From the initial page, Tab reached Skip to place search and Return focused search. Keyboard search found Trevi and the garden; Tab reached each list control, Return opened details and Shift+Tab reached Add. In the first dialog, Escape restored the list opener, and forward/backward Tab wrapped between Close and Add. Two additions produced the same day. Keyboard activation of Review focused its heading and showed both numbered selected pins despite the retained garden search. Earlier moved the garden to stop 1 at 09:30 and Trevi to stop 2 at 11:10. Remove retained Trevi and focused Undo; Return restored the garden in the same order and focused that stop. A fresh final single-add check displayed 1 stop. The case-return link was also observed.
